title: Smart Campus Innovation Hackathon 2026
description: A 36-hour continuous collegiate hackathon challenging multidisciplinary student squads to build scalable software and IoT hardware prototypes addressing campus sustainability, energy metering, and library automation.
eligibility: Open to FE, SE, TE & BE Students of All Engineering Disciplines
location: KBTCOE Main Auditorium & Robotics Lab, Nashik

title: Full-Stack Cloud Systems Summer Internship
description: An intensive 8-week paid summer internship program working directly alongside senior cloud architects to build high-throughput microservices using Node.js, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS services.
eligibility: TE & BE Students (Computer, IT, and AI & Data Science)

title: State-Level Bridge Structural Design Championship
description: Inter-college engineering contest evaluating student teams on structural analysis, load simulation, and drafting of sustainable pedestrian cable-stayed bridges using modern CAD and FEM tools.
eligibility: SE, TE & BE Students (Civil & Mechanical Engineering)

title: Hands-On Industrial Automation & PLC/SCADA Workshop
description: A comprehensive 3-day practical bootcamp covering programmable logic controllers (PLCs), ladder logic programming, industrial sensor telemetry, and SCADA supervisory control screens.

title: Applied Computer Vision & Edge AI Fellowship
description: A 10-week technical research internship training deep learning vision models on drone imagery for early crop pest detection and deploying lightweight quantized neural networks onto Raspberry Pi edge nodes.
eligibility: TE & BE Students (AI & DS, Comp, IT, or E&TC)
reward: ₹12,000 / month Stipend + Co-authorship in IEEE Paper

title: Formula Student Electric Vehicle CAD Challenge
description: Design competition challenging student engineers to model an aerodynamic, lightweight battery enclosure and composite chassis space frame adhering to formula student EV safety regulations.
reward: ₹30,000 Cash Prize + Technical Sponsorship for SAE BAJA

title: Cybersecurity & Web Penetration Testing Masterclass
description: An interactive weekend masterclass demonstrating OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities, SQL injection mitigation, JWT authentication security, and Capture The Flag (CTF) defensive techniques.
eligibility: All Students with Basic Web & Networking Knowledge
reward: Hands-on CTF Badge + Certificate of Completion

title: National Smart City IoT Telemetry Innovation Sprint
organization: Nashik Municipal Smart City Development Corporation
description: 48-hour open innovation sprint inviting engineering innovators to prototype municipal water flow monitoring, smart street lighting grids, and air pollution sensory nodes across urban sectors.

title: Mobile App UI/UX Design & Flutter Developer Internship
description: A 12-week development internship building accessible, cross-platform Android & iOS student companion tools with responsive Flutter interfaces, Firebase real-time synchronization, and Figma design systems.
reward: ₹14,000 / month Stipend + Google Play Store Publication
